text: だれが　おぼえて　くれるの？

structure.jp: おぼえて　くれるの？

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる after a verb says someone does it as a favour for the speaker. おぼえて　くれる = 'learn it for me'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a question is a soft form of のだ that asks for an explanation. くれるの = 'will they do it for me?'.
